name: La Plagne
description: La Plagne is 11 villages spread across a high-altitude plateau, paired with Les Arcs via the Vanoise Express to form Paradiski (425 km). The terrain spans two huge bowls from glacier (Bellecôte, 3,250 m) to wooded valley runs. 7 core villages (Plagne Centre, Belle Plagne, Plagne-Soleil, Plagne-Villages, Plagne-Bellecôte, Plagne 1800, Aime 2000) plus 4 outlying villages (Champagny-en-Vanoise, Montalbert, Les Coches, Montchavin). Home to France's only Olympic bobsleigh track (1.5 km, 19 bends, 124.5 m drop). Family-friendly with 61% beginner terrain.

overview.atmosphere: World's largest single ski resort (225 km) — 11 villages across the plateau. France's only Olympic bobsleigh track. Family-friendly, hidden freeride paradise. Linked to Les Arcs via Vanoise Express to complete 425 km Paradiski.

beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Super Tyro — from Plagne Aime 2000 to Plagne Centre. Colorado Park — 1,500 m run with Mont Blanc views. Plagne Centre: Le Holidays (14:00-02:00, 6 lanes, arcade, bar). Belle Plagne: Cosy bar, cocktails, beers, tapas, oysters, billiards, pinball, arcade games.. Cinema at Plagne Centre. Paragliding (Air La Plagne), dog sledding, ice climbing, biathlon, snowshoeing, ice skating, squash, escape games, handiski

villages.name: Plagne Centre
villages.character: Largest, liveliest, best shops, restaurants, bars, cinema, bowling (Le Holidays, 14:00-02:00), Colorado toboggan run (1,500 m), hub of La Plagne events

villages.name: Belle Plagne
villages.character: Highest core village, 360° panorama, Deep Nature Premium Spa (1,500 m², hammam, nordic baths, saunas), Family SPA (35° outdoor pool, aqua trail), Bellecôte glacier access

villages.name: Plagne 1800
villages.character: Traditional stone-built, market town feel, near bobsleigh track

villages.name: Aime 2000
villages.character: High-altitude, direct lift access, quiet evenings

villages.name: Champagny-en-Vanoise
villages.character: Traditional Savoyard village, valley floor, Glacier Museum (Espace Glacialis)

villages.name: Les Coches
villages.character: Wooded hamlet, tree skiing, near Vanoise Express

villages.name: Montchavin
villages.character: Stone village below Vanoise Express, closest to Les Arcs link

honest_drawbacks: Fragmented villages — no single resort atmosphere
Lifts get crowded — queues are common
